name: Lucie: Petaluma area, up to $1.2M
business_types: other home services that do not need a contractor's license
business_type_guidance: Home-service businesses qualify only if the work does not need a contractor's license (for example a California CSLB license). Yard care and gardening qualify; landscaping that needs a licensed contractor (C-27) does not. Physical therapy clinics and MedSpas qualify even though their staff hold professional licenses.
